what_is_counted: cell bodies or nuclei inside optical disectors placed by systematic random sampling at known sampling fractions
cell_classes_resolved: neurons and glia by morphology; glial subtypes, endothelial cells and named neuron types with stains or markers
typical_outputs: total number per structure (N); with a Cavalieri volume also a density per mm3
density_basis: count per structure; any density is per mm3 of processed tissue
main_limitations: small neurons can be scored as glia in Nissl or H&E material; bias from z-axis shrinkage, lost caps and particle loss; depends on sampling design and clear borders
references: von Bartheld, Bahney & Herculano-Houzel 2016 J Comp Neurol 524:3865 doi:10.1002/cne.24040; Herculano-Houzel, von Bartheld, Miller & Kaas 2015 Cell Tissue Res 360:29 doi:10.1007/s00441-015-2127-6

method_label: Design-based stereology: optical or physical disector density (Nv), usually with a Cavalieri volume
what_is_counted: cells (or other particles) per disector volume; total = Nv x reference volume
typical_outputs: numerical density Nv (per mm3); total N when multiplied by a reference volume; glia-neuron ratio
main_limitations: density depends on tissue shrinkage and on how the reference volume is defined (the reference trap); small-neuron vs glia classification as above
references: von Bartheld, Bahney & Herculano-Houzel 2016 J Comp Neurol 524:3865 doi:10.1002/cne.24040

method_label: Design-based stereology, probe not recorded in this repository
density_basis: per mm3 of processed tissue unless the source says otherwise
main_limitations: as for the other design-based probes; record the probe when an expert confirms it
references: von Bartheld, Bahney & Herculano-Houzel 2016 J Comp Neurol 524:3865 doi:10.1002/cne.24040
notes: placeholder until the source's probe (fractionator or disector) is confirmed

method_label: Model-based profile counts with a correction formula (e.g. Abercrombie)
what_is_counted: profiles of nuclei or nucleoli in thin sections, corrected using assumed particle size and section thickness
typical_outputs: density per mm3; totals as density x volume
main_limitations: result depends on assumptions about particle size and shape and on section thickness; shrinkage; small neurons vs glia
references: von Bartheld, Bahney & Herculano-Houzel 2016 J Comp Neurol 524:3865 doi:10.1002/cne.24040

method_label: Profile or nucleolus counts without size correction (including counts per strip or prism)
what_is_counted: cells with a visible nucleus or nucleolus in a section, sample box or strip
typical_outputs: counts per sample, density per mm3, totals as density x volume
density_basis: per sample volume or per mm3 of processed tissue, usually without shrinkage correction
main_limitations: no correction for particle size, so large and small cells are sampled unequally; shrinkage; glial inclusion; one or few animals
references: von Bartheld, Bahney & Herculano-Houzel 2016 J Comp Neurol 524:3865 doi:10.1002/cne.24040; Herculano-Houzel, Collins, Wong, Kaas & Lent 2008 PNAS 105:12593 doi:10.1073/pnas.0805417105

method_label: Histological count whose probe or correction is not recorded here (includes 1980s early stereology)
main_limitations: unknown until an expert checks the source

method_label: Two-dimensional counts per area of section or per microscope field
what_is_counted: profiles per mm2 of section or per field, without a disector
typical_outputs: cells per mm2 of section; cells per field; percentages
density_basis: per mm2 of section or per field (not volumetric)
main_limitations: depends on section thickness and cell size; comparable only within one protocol
references: von Bartheld, Bahney & Herculano-Houzel 2016 J Comp Neurol 524:3865 doi:10.1002/cne.24040

method_label: Isotropic fractionator: nuclei in suspension counted in a hemocytometer; neurons by NeuN
what_is_counted: all nuclei of a dissected structure after homogenisation; NeuN-positive fraction by microscopy
cell_classes_resolved: neurons vs all non-neuronal cells (glia plus endothelial cells); extra markers for some glial types
typical_outputs: total cells, neurons and non-neurons per structure; densities per mg; non-neuron to neuron ratio (nNNR)
main_limitations: no spatial information; dissectible structures only; NeuN-negative neurons count as non-neuronal; non-neuronal includes endothelial cells so the ratio is nNNR not GNR
references: Herculano-Houzel, von Bartheld, Miller & Kaas 2015 Cell Tissue Res 360:29 doi:10.1007/s00441-015-2127-6; Bahney & von Bartheld 2014 J Neurosci Methods 222:165 doi:10.1016/j.jneumeth.2013.11.002; von Bartheld, Bahney & Herculano-Houzel 2016 J Comp Neurol 524:3865 doi:10.1002/cne.24040

method_label: Flow fractionator: isotropic fractionator with counting by flow cytometry
what_is_counted: as the isotropic fractionator, with nuclei and the NeuN fraction counted by flow cytometry
typical_outputs: cells and neurons per piece or area; densities per g or per area of cortex
density_basis: per g of tissue or per area of cortical surface
main_limitations: as the isotropic fractionator; per-area values depend on how surface area was measured
references: von Bartheld, Bahney & Herculano-Houzel 2016 J Comp Neurol 524:3865 doi:10.1002/cne.24040; Herculano-Houzel, von Bartheld, Miller & Kaas 2015 Cell Tissue Res 360:29 doi:10.1007/s00441-015-2127-6

what_is_counted: nuclei of unfixed or sonicated tissue counted in suspension
cell_classes_resolved: poor; small neurons taken for glia
main_limitations: nuclei lost or ruptured; counts reported to be too low by at least a third (as reviewed); poor cell-type distinction
references: von Bartheld, Bahney & Herculano-Houzel 2016 J Comp Neurol 524:3865 doi:10.1002/cne.24040
notes: no source in the repository uses this method on 2026-11-04

what_is_counted: total DNA divided by DNA per nucleus
main_limitations: incomplete recovery; poor yield in fixed white matter; polyploidy; no cell types
references: von Bartheld, Bahney & Herculano-Houzel 2016 J Comp Neurol 524:3865 doi:10.1002/cne.24040; Bahney & von Bartheld 2014 J Neurosci Methods 222:165 doi:10.1016/j.jneumeth.2013.11.002
notes: no source in the repository uses this method on 2026-11-04

method_label: Counts of neurons labelled by a tract tracer (e.g. retrograde HRP)
what_is_counted: neurons that project to the injection site (a subpopulation)
density_basis: per mm2 or mm3 of section, or per region
main_limitations: depends on tracer uptake and transport; not a count of all cells or all neurons

method_label: Secondary compilation; the method is that of each cited source
typical_outputs: ratios, densities and totals from mixed methods
main_limitations: mixed methods and eras; may duplicate primary sources already in the repository
decided_by: house rule (build HOWTO invariant 6: only primary data is merged)
notes: record the cited source's method per row in source_methods.csv when a secondary value is ever used

method_label: Not a cell count (soma size, axon or vessel measures, synapses, fibres)
notes: routing rows: parts of a counting source that belong in another merge
